about: T-483 (5): THE FIELD's intent. With the FIELD set, the numbers go dark and the foe shows what it has settled on before the player chooses: its sprite breathes toward the colour of the TYPE of the routine it will run, and moves -- a lunge toward the lead for a routine that strikes, a shimmer in place for one that shapes, a lean away for a switch or a flight. Each turn below captures one 64-frame breath while the menu waits, with the routine the foe settled on read out of RAM (gChosenMoveByBattler[1]) beside it. Uses the theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's.
